messages:
matt: Quick check — our next ship window lands the week that overlaps the EU bank holiday. Can the cadence shift one day earlier that week or should we keep the usual slot and adjust the ops plan? cc @priya @leo :calendar:

priya: I prefer moving it a day earlier if possible. avoids the holiday risk and gives the SREs a full business day after release. can take the coordination for changelog/tagging.

leo: moving a day is fine from infra side but heads-up: CI queue on gpu runners is already tight that week. if we move, we should enable the canary traffic cap to avoid overload.

jana: two options that would work for me:
1) shift the ship to Thu (one day earlier) and run a light canary for 4 hours post-ship
2) keep Fri ship but start the branch protection + freeze 24h earlier and stagger rollout to regions
Pros/cons: (1) less holiday risk, (2) simpler CI timing but longer ops window.

matt: @jana can you spell out the branch steps for option (2)? want to be clear on what owners must do.

jana: sure — for option (2) checklist:
- update protected branch rule to block merges except for release/* PRs
- hand back any in-flight PRs to authors to rebase
- create release branch: `git checkout -b release/vX.Y.Z`
- bump versions and add changelog entries
- open small merge window for emergency fixes only

Code snippet for bump/tag (example):
```
# from repo root
git checkout -b release/v1.12.0
# update VERSION and CHANGELOG.md
git commit -am "release: v1.12.0"
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "v1.12.0"
git push origin release/v1.12.0 --tags
```

deploy-bot: Reminder: nightly build scheduled 2026-04-01T02:00Z. If you shift the ship to Thu, please update the release calendar here: https://calendar.redwood.example/release-cadence :robot_face:

sara: Quick note on changelog — please add short bullet under "infra" for the canary traffic cap change and tag who verified the canary. also ping support to prep the status banner draft.

priya: I got the changelog + tag. will open the PR today and add reviewers @sara @leo.

leo: I'll prepare the canary PR to add the traffic cap and fallback route. will include rollout config and monitoring alerts.

jana: sounds good. final asks: matt can you update the calendar invite with the chosen option? and i'll notify eng-oncall for that ship week.

matt: will update invites and post final plan by EOD. thanks all. :thumbsup:
